cards.title: Robotic system not responding with AGVs stopped or out of sync
cards.user_facing_summary: Use this troubleshooting flow when a site reports that robotic operation has stopped, AGVs are not moving or are out of sync, small sort activity has stopped, or the RMS view is blank or abnormal. Confirm the observable system state, inspect service and application evidence, recover the affected service or gateway through an authorized procedure, correct residual AGV state, and validate both service responsiveness and resumed operation.
observed_entry_symptoms: Nothing is moving across the site or bots are stopped in multiple areas.
The robotic system is reported as not responding.
Small sort operation is not running.
AGVs are reported out of sync or several AGVs stop after a heartbeat issue.
Totes cannot be removed from the hospital workflow.
RMS or HMI is mostly blank or displays an apparent ".NET Control not created." message.
The site reports no obvious failed AGV even though automated movement has stopped.

node_retrieval_summaries.intent: Determine whether the report represents a broad robotic-operation stoppage with an abnormal RMS or HMI presentation rather than an isolated AGV issue.
node_retrieval_summaries.runbook_placeholder: Procedure needed to confirm with the site whether the affected zone or workflow has broad loss of movement, whether small sort or hospital handling is also stopped, and whether RMS/HMI shows a populated normal status view or a blank/control-not-created presentation. Use generic affected-zone and reported-robot questioning rather than incident-specific identifiers.
node_retrieval_summaries.expected_or_observed_result: The site or operator confirms whether the affected area has broad loss of movement, whether the small sort or hospital workflow is also affected, and whether RMS/HMI is blank or shows an abnormal control message. In RMS/HMI, a healthy or alternate pattern is normal populated system status with localized impact only; an unhealthy pattern is broad stopped operation with blank or abnormal system presentation; inconclusive means the scope, affected workflow, or displayed message cannot be confirmed.

node_retrieval_summaries.title: Check whether Ignition gateway health is abnormal or merely a related observation
node_retrieval_summaries.intent: Determine whether the Ignition gateway shows a current responsiveness problem or whether the memory observation is only follow-up context.
node_retrieval_summaries.runbook_placeholder: Procedure needed to inspect the Ignition gateway Systems Overview for gateway responsiveness, current response behavior, recent slow-response events, and available CPU or memory trend evidence, while treating unlabeled trend changes as inconclusive unless correlated with a confirmed failure.
node_retrieval_summaries.expected_or_observed_result: L1/L2 support observes the Ignition Systems Overview and available memory or CPU trend evidence. A healthy signal is a responding gateway with a current response time and no recent slow-response events; an unhealthy signal is an unavailable or nonresponsive gateway or a clearly abnormal resource trend correlated with the stoppage; inconclusive means the snapshot is stale, the trend lacks labels, or the gateway state cannot be verified.

ontology_capabilities.relevant_evidence: The packet directly shows an Ignition gateway Systems Overview with response and slow-response indicators.

ontology_gaps: The supplied evidence does not identify the meaning of the memory chart reference line or provide a validated causal threshold.

Recent Slow Response Events shows no events to display.

unhealthy_indicators: Ignition gateway cannot be reached or does not respond.
Recent slow-response activity or other gateway health indicators are clearly abnormal.
A resource trend is visibly abnormal and temporally correlates with the operational failure.
inconclusive_indicators: A memory trend changes sharply without a labeled threshold or causal evidence.
The snapshot has no reliable timestamp or is not clearly from the affected gateway.
The gateway responds normally after the incident but historical state cannot be reconstructed.

An AMR is reported with low battery or is physically under a rack.
The site reports that AMR behavior remains abnormal after an attempted replacement.
